Tool metadata shared by the chat shell. It both configures the tool-preferences popover (`name`/`label`/`group`) and carries the schema derived from a clicky RPC operation (`description`/`inputSchema`). The Go backend owns execution; the client uses this only for display and to scope which tools a request may call (passed in the transport `body`).

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/ai/ToolPreferences.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { ToolMode } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/ai";
```
